column5: appends one 32-bit token ((modifier & 0x3fff) << 16 | opcode & 0xffff) to the growable instruction array {count, capacity, data} (grows by 0x80 entries)

encodes the destination operand of an EXT_vertex_shader op: write-mask bits plus the output register class (GL_OUTPUT_VERTEX_EXT 0x879a, OUTPUT_COLOR0/1 0x879b/c, OUTPUT_TEXTURE_COORDn 0x879d.., OUTPUT_FOG_EXT 0x87bd, variants/locals via the symbol table)

encodes one source operand: four 3-bit swizzle selectors from the EXT swizzle enumerants (GL_X_EXT 0x87d5 .. GL_W_EXT 0x87d8, NEGATIVE_X..W 0x87d9..0x87dc, ZERO_EXT 0x87dd, ONE_EXT 0x87de), negate/abs bits, then the register class from the symbol (variant 0x87c1, invariant 0x87c2, local constant 0x87c3, local 0x87c4; scalar 0x87be, vector 0x87bf, matrix 0x87c0)
emits mova then mov (index/addressing form of the op)
IL mov (0x47), one destination, one source
IL dp3 (0x22), destination plus two sources
IL expp (0x2e), source taken as scalar
IL logp (0x3d) with an x-replicating swizzle override
